summary: Configured `opsbot` on both nodes. The node1-generated ED25519 key provides command access to node2, and both systems require public-key authentication for `opsbot`. Configuration and access survived sequential restarts of both nodes.
actions_performed: Created and password-locked `opsbot` on node1 and node2.
Generated an ED25519 key as `opsbot` on node1 and authorized it on both nodes.
Configured per-user SSH policy requiring public-key authentication and disabling password and keyboard-interactive authentication.
Verified successful key-based command execution on both nodes and rejection of password-only attempts.
Restarted node1 and node2 sequentially and verified changed boot identities and full recovery.

evidence.summary: `opsbot` exists on both nodes; key files have correct ownership and permissions; authorized-key fingerprints match node1's generated key.
Effective sshd policy requires `publickey`; live key logins succeed on both nodes, while password-only attempts fail.
Shows healthy baseline, restart acknowledgement, changed boot ID, restored sshd listener, persisted account/key/policy, and successful post-restart key logins.

Shows healthy baseline, restart acknowledgement, changed boot ID, restored sshd listener, persisted account/key/policy, successful post-restart key access from node1, and continued password rejection.
